outcomes.refuse: the compile fails and nothing is emitted
outcomes.warn: the compile goes on and the warning is carried in full into the resolution report

checks.title: The specification is well formed at a spec_version this compiler implements: known fields only, each of its declared type
checks.prevents: A field nobody reads, which its author will later believe was honoured

checks.title: The network fingerprint the specification names equals the world package's
checks.prevents: Authoring against a road graph other than the one that renders

checks.title: The package's network and OpenDRIVE came from one netconvert invocation, and the network it carries is the one it records
checks.prevents: A network and a map from two runs, which disagree about lanes

checks.title: The network's convBoundary equals the OpenDRIVE header's north, south, east and west
checks.prevents: A network in a different frame from the map

checks.title: The network's projParameter equals world.json's GeoReferenceString
checks.prevents: Origin drift between the network and the world

checks.title: The network's netOffset is zero
checks.prevents: A network whose metres are displaced from the world's geographic frame

checks.title: The SUMO release routing the scenario is the one that built the world, by release number, unless the mismatch is explicitly accepted
checks.against: world.json NetconvertVersion and the SUMO installation
checks.prevents: Traffic routed by one duarouter release on a network another built: a different release can route the same demand differently

checks.title: Every declared place resolves, and to exactly one thing; every lane a closure names is on its edge
checks.against: the network, the place index and the area table
checks.prevents: An authored place that silently becomes a different place

checks.title: Every reference names what the specification declares: places, instants, rotas, series, flows, counterfactuals and exemplar instances
checks.prevents: A typo becoming a valid-looking identifier

checks.title: Every actor, rota entry, flow, lane closure and capture window id is unique
checks.prevents: Two vehicles SUMO would read as one, or a window cited ambiguously

checks.title: Every stop position lies within its lane's length
checks.prevents: A dwell clamped to somewhere other than where it was authored

checks.title: Every vehicle's class may drive every edge of its route
checks.against: lane allow and disallow in map.net.xml
checks.prevents: A route through a fence the vehicle cannot pass

checks.title: Every origin, destination and via routes
checks.prevents: No valid route at SUMO load, after a capture was scheduled

checks.title: Each routed result ends on the requested destination and passes every via and stop edge in order
checks.prevents: duarouter's false accept: a trip to a nonexistent edge routes as one edge

checks.title: An explicit edge list is connected end to end
checks.prevents: A break that appears only where the list is used

checks.title: Every route through a lane closure enters and leaves the closed edge on a lane the closure leaves open
checks.against: map.net.xml lane connections and the routed routes
checks.prevents: SUMO refusing to insert a vehicle whose route the closure breaks, and stopping the run

checks.title: Every vehicle class names only blueprints the catalogue measured, and every named mix draws on declared classes at positive shares under an id of its own
checks.against: the vehicle catalogue and the specification
checks.prevents: A type with no body, discovered at spawn

checks.title: Every emitted vType's length, width and height are its blueprint's measured box
checks.prevents: SUMO's gaps and CARLA's rendering disagreeing by the difference

checks.title: Every type a flow or actor names is a declared class, one of its member types, the mix or a named mix
checks.prevents: A vehicle drawn from a type nothing declares

checks.title: A vehicle class draws from more than one body
checks.prevents: Appearance becoming the label: every member of the class is the same car

checks.title: Every label is a declared term and every role but subject a declared role; an annotation carries a label; the declarations resolve inside the published vocabulary
checks.prevents: A label spelled three ways in one corpus, or one no consumer can read

checks.title: Every label's applies_to includes the subject kind, and its realisation the instance's realisation
checks.prevents: A per-member term on a flow, or an absence term on a vehicle

checks.title: Every namespace in a label, role, phase or area kind was declared or imported
checks.prevents: A term no published vocabulary defines

checks.title: Every parameter an instance, absence, series or cohort carries is declared by one of its labels' terms and is of the declared type; labels declaring one key agree on its type and unit
checks.prevents: A magnitude no consumer can read: a key nobody defined, or a value that is not what its definition says

checks.title: A nominal subject's hard_negative_for is the set its labels' terms declare, and no other subject declares one
checks.prevents: A matched negative the record and its term disagree about

checks.title: Every participant names a declared actor
checks.prevents: An instance whose participant never exists

checks.title: Every aoi_ref names an area in the world's area table
checks.prevents: An annotation naming a place only its author can see

checks.title: Instance ids are derived from the scenario id and the authored name, and unique
checks.prevents: Sweep members that cannot be joined

checks.title: No annotated interval begins before its participant departs
checks.prevents: An interval no vehicle could have been in

checks.title: A cohort carries only a whole-life annotation, never an interval
checks.prevents: A phase asserted over a generator whose members are unknown until the run

checks.title: No cohort is nominal
checks.prevents: A negative asserted of vehicles nobody authored one by one

checks.title: A one-participant instance names its participant subject; the phase vacancy is never authored
checks.prevents: A consumer guessing which track an instance is about

checks.title: Some subject is nominal when any is annotated
checks.prevents: A corpus with no hard negatives

checks.title: Area ids unique, rings closed and not self-intersecting, radius positive
checks.prevents: Undefined containment; the compiler reads only a table the world build validated

checks.title: An area's envelope intersects the world
checks.prevents: An area outside the world entirely

checks.title: A referenced area is not in the staging ring
checks.against: the area table's V5.5 and V5.6 warnings
checks.prevents: A pattern sited where traffic spawns and despawns

checks.title: A referenced area can be reached by a road vehicle
checks.prevents: An area no vehicle can reach

checks.title: The epoch is present and accepted by CarlaNet.CoSim.SolarEpoch under every 04 C9 epoch rule
checks.prevents: A scenario whose seconds mean no civil time

checks.title: utc_offset_hours is a whole number of quarter hours in [-12, +14]
checks.prevents: An offset no civil zone uses, or one the engine would clamp

checks.title: The zone name's offset agrees with utc_offset_hours
checks.against: none: time_zone_id is carried and never resolved
checks.prevents: Retired: 04 §11.3 and 11 D11.1 make the zone name provenance only

checks.title: Every authored time is in an accepted form, names its day on a multi-day scenario, and carries the epoch's offset when absolute
checks.prevents: A clock-shaped literal that is really an offset

checks.title: Every rota expands to entries, and every skip matches an entry it would have produced
checks.prevents: An absence that was never planted

checks.title: Every resolved instant lies in [0, end]
checks.prevents: An instant that silently falls outside the run

checks.title: A window's civil date differs from the date its sun is written with
checks.against: the epoch's calendar_advances and the policy
checks.prevents: A window rendered under another date's seasonal sun without notice

checks.title: Every capture window lies in the span and cuts no supervision interval
checks.against: the specification and the supervision plan
checks.prevents: A partially observed positive teaching a truncated pattern

checks.title: The illumination default is accepted by CarlaNet.CoSim.IlluminationPolicy; an advancing sun's arc per window is named
checks.prevents: A window authored as a constant that is not one

checks.title: The declared offset is within an hour of the zone the world's georeference configures
checks.prevents: A declared offset that is not this place's

checks.title: A window whose sun is below -6 degrees is named as not corpus-eligible
checks.prevents: A night window captured by accident

checks.title: The illumination-label association over the declared windows
checks.against: the resolved instants, the supervision plan and the sun
checks.prevents: Discovering after training that the light carried the label

checks.title: A sweep holds illumination while it varies behaviour, varies only illumination when it says so, and names a crossed design; a counterfactual pair shares its base's epoch, windows and illumination unless displaced in time
checks.prevents: A behaviour sweep captured under different light

checks.title: The route file is departure-sorted
checks.prevents: SUMO dropping out-of-order entries with only a warning

checks.title: No XML comment contains --
checks.prevents: SUMO rejecting the file

checks.title: No emitted SUMO file carries an H:M:S time
checks.prevents: An offset wearing a clock's clothes

checks.title: The route file is valid against SUMO's routes_file.xsd, and the additional file, where there is one, against its additional_file.xsd
checks.prevents: A file SUMO will not load

checks.title: The route file carries no parameter but the vehicle-type binding's
checks.prevents: Supervision leaking into the route file, the channel it must never use

checks.title: The run ends after every declared interval and departure
checks.prevents: A behaviour truncated by the run ending

checks.title: Every flow's window lies inside the run
checks.prevents: A flow that never fires
